plans.title: Plans
plans.description: Every plan is for this workspace only. Pick the one that fits and switch whenever you need to.
plans.empty: No plans have been set up yet. Ask your platform administrator to create one.
plans.readOnly: Only workspace owners and admins can change the plan. You can see the plans and what each includes.

banner.expired: Your plan expired on {date}. Paid features are paused. Renew below to restore them.
banner.activeUntil: Your plan is active until {date} ({days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left).
banner.activeForever: Your plan has no end date.
banner.trial: Your free trial ends on {date} ({days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left). Choose a plan to keep your workspace active.
banner.trialEnded: Your free trial ended on {date}. Choose a plan to keep using your workspace.
banner.customQuote: Your plan is managed with our sales team.

confirm.title: Switch to {name}?
confirm.downgradeBody: Your workspace moves to {name} straight away. Nothing you have is deleted, but anything above the new limits can no longer be added to until you are back under them.
confirm.switchBody: Your workspace moves to {name} straight away.
confirm.keepsPeriod: The paid time you have left stays on your workspace.

result.overLimit: These are above the new plan's limits, so you can't add more until you are under them:

errors.PLAN_CHECKOUT_REQUIRED: That plan needs a payment. Continue to checkout.
errors.PLAN_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED: That plan can't be selected right now.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to change the plan.
errors.generic: We couldn't change the plan. Please try again.

renewal.confirmBody: Your plan stays active until it expires, then it will not renew.
renewal.cancelled: Auto-renew cancelled. Your plan stays active until it expires.
renewal.forbidden: You don't have permission to change the plan.
renewal.none: There is no active subscription to cancel.
renewal.failed: We couldn't cancel auto-renew. Please try again.

bar.trial: {days, plural, one {You have # day} other {You have # days}} to explore this trial workspace. Connect a channel to unlock all features.
bar.trialEnded: Your free trial has ended. Buy a plan to unlock all features.
bar.renew: {days, plural, one {Your plan expires in # day} other {Your plan expires in # days}} on {date}. Renew to keep your features.
bar.autoRenew: {days, plural, one {Your plan auto-renews in # day} other {Your plan auto-renews in # days}} on {date}.

usage.title: Plan and usage
usage.description: What this workspace is on, what it has used and what it can still do.
usage.moreOnHigher: {count, plural, one {# more feature unlocks} other {# more features unlock}} on a higher plan.

operator.title: Workspace plans
operator.description: See which plan every workspace is on. Super admins can attach a plan to a workspace and set limits for that workspace alone.
operator.readOnly: Only super admins can change a workspace's plan or limits.
operator.search: Search by workspace name or slug

dialog.title: Plan and limits for {name}
dialog.endsHint: Leave empty to use the plan's own period when the plan changes, or keep the current date when it stays the same.
dialog.limitsHint: Empty uses the plan's limit. 0 or -1 means unlimited for this workspace.
dialog.changesTrial: Changing the plan ends the workspace's free trial.
dialog.conflict: Someone changed this workspace's plan. Reload and try again.

faqs.title: Pricing FAQs
faqs.description: The questions shown on the plans page and the public pricing page. The lowest sort order shows first.
faqs.readOnly: Only super admins can change FAQs.
faqs.empty: No FAQs yet. Add one above.
faqs.question: Question
faqs.answerHint: Plain text. Markdown is not supported.
faqs.deleteBody: This FAQ is removed for good.
faqs.conflict: Someone changed this FAQ. Reload and try again.
faqs.invalid: Check the question, answer and sort order.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.description: Paid plans can set a retention period. A workspace whose paid plan ended longer ago than that has its data deleted once, by a nightly job. A preview deletes nothing.
retention.previewDone: {count, plural, =0 {No workspaces are due.} one {# workspace is due.} other {# workspaces are due.}}
retention.wiped: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing was wiped.} one {# workspace was wiped.} other {# workspaces were wiped.}}
retention.forbidden: Only super admins can run this.
retention.failed: The run failed. Nothing was changed.

public.title: Simple, honest, and flat.
public.lead: Pick the plan that fits. Change it any time.
public.empty: Pricing isn't available right now. Please check back soon.
